item.title: Char Dham temple panels consider move to restrict entry for non-Hindus
item.description: Temple committees overseeing Uttarakhand’s Char Dham shrines are weighing proposals that could restrict the entry of non-Hindus into temple premises, triggering confusion within the boards themselves and criticism from opposition leaders.

item.title: Rights group says more than 6,100 killed in Iran protest crackdown
item.description: At least 6,126 people have been killed during Iran’s crackdown on nationwide protests, according to figures released on Tuesday by a human rights organisation, which said the true toll is likely to be even higher.

item.title: Death toll from US strikes on alleged drug boats rises to 126
item.description: The United States military has confirmed that 126 people have died in strikes on vessels accused of drug trafficking, including those now presumed dead after being lost at sea, officials said on Monday.

item.title: Maha: Tribals accuse state of forced evictions, protest at Eknath Shinde’s residence
item.description: Members of tribal communities living in and around Sanjay Gandhi National Park staged a late-night protest outside the Thane residence of Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde, opposing the demolition of their hamlets by the authorities.

item.title: Carney says Trump’s tariff threats are negotiation tactics ahead of USMCA review
item.description: Canadian PM Mark Carney says Donald Trump’s tariff threats against Canada should be seen as negotiating tactics ahead of this year’s USMCA review, not as signs of immediate policy action.

item.title: UP government suspends city magistrate after resignation over UGC rules sparks row
item.description: The Uttar Pradesh government has suspended Bareilly City Magistrate Alankar Agnihotri on charges of indiscipline after his resignation in protest against government policies triggered a political and administrative storm.

item.title: Snowfall disrupts flights and transport in Kashmir as tourists left stranded
item.description: Heavy snowfall across Kashmir led to the cancellation of several flights at Srinagar International Airport on Tuesday, stranding hundreds of tourists who had planned to leave the Valley after the weekend and Republic Day holiday.

item.title: Kidnapped son of Jamshedpur industrialist rescued after 12 days
item.description: The son of a Jamshedpur-based industrialist, who was abducted earlier this month, was rescued by police in the early hours of Tuesday, bringing a dramatic end to a case that had caused widespread concern in the region.

item.title: Rupee recovers from record low as dollar weakens ahead of Fed cues
item.description: The rupee edged higher in early trade on Tuesday, recovering from record low levels to strengthen by 10 paise against the US dollar as the greenback retreated from recent highs.

item.title: Eight killed in South 24 Parganas warehouse fire as blaze continues to smoulder
item.description: At least eight people have been killed in a massive fire that broke out at two adjoining warehouses in West Bengal’s South 24 Parganas district, with firefighters still struggling to fully extinguish the blaze more than 24 hours after it began.
